messages.subject: Question on phylogenetically-controlled regression
parts:
Hi D-RUG,

I have an analysis question I was hoping someone on the listserv could help me answer. I am trying to do a phylogenetically-controlled regression for a meta-analysis of Procellariiform seabirds. For each species included I have multiple measurements per species of the dependent variable (in this case, it's the proportion diet that is crustacea), but single measurements (thus no variance) for the independent variable (in this case it's the log-transformed weight of each species). 

I have ran regular PGLS models to control for phylogeny, but, I can only do so for each species mean y-value, thus leaving out a lot of data. I tried to use the recently published pgls.Ives function, to account for multiple measurements in the dependent variable, but I keep on receiving an error I don't understand. 

If anyone works with these kinds of analyses and might be able to tell me what's going on, it would be greatly appreciated! Coped below, is my code and the associated data (.csv attached to this email). 

Thanks in advance for your help!
Matt
